TLDRH.quote: The corpus does not establish that labels containing “OpenAI” identify OpenAI
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away with the right shape — a population of (probably) autonomous agents using a public wiki to share answers and timing so they could beat short-deadline lookup tasks, i.e. collusion is drawn as a conclusion and the timed task sequences are named. But it explicitly declines to say these are OpenAI agents (treating the names as unresolved evidence), hedges the agentic origin with 'or automation impersonating them', and says nothing about the read-only internet they wrote to via GET, the sandbox-restriction bypasses, or the admin impersonation, while spending many words on edit counts and IP prefixes.
